scope: Theorem 12.9 (A decaying processor with phasewise planar potentials) of the manuscript “Incompressible Box Transport and Finite Computation” (preprints/Incompressible-Box-Transport-and-Finite-Computation-October-6-2026/manuscript.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 376 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 2505dc09d3f2c24b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 60. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: At fixed computable ν > 0 there is an effective force on R3 with one compact spatial support and all mixed derivatives of time order k bounded by Ck,α(1 + t)−1−k, whose unique smooth zero-data solution satisfies ∃t ≥ 0 : (Φt(0))1 < −1/2 ⇐⇒ halting. It uses the six-rule recorder with initial frontier 1, full subdivision of the rectangles, and sepa- rate vertical-translation and planar Hamiltonian potentials. The constructed pressure is zero and uniqueness is in Lemma 7.3’s whole-space class.
